title: API: a 255-character part number and description are accepted on create, and 256 characters are refused
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Take <cat> and <defaultBin> ids from the requests the New Inventory Part dialog loads; create body: {"partNumber":…,"description":…,"categoryId":"<cat>","vendorId":null,"manufacturerId":null,"quantity":0,"cost":"10.00","sellPrice":null,"min":0,"max":0,"gridLocation":null,"coreCharge":null,"environmentalCharge":null,"tags":["qa"],"bins":[{"id":"<defaultBin>","quantity":0,"isDefault":true}],"isFixedPrice":false}. Strings (build them in the DevTools console): N255 = "QA255-" + "N".repeat(249) (255 characters); D255 = "QA 255 desc " + "D".repeat(243) (255 characters); N256 / D256 = the same with one more N / D (256 characters).
custom_steps:
1. Send POST /api/inventory/parts/create (create body) with partNumber N255 and description D255.
  2. Search "QA255-" on /parts/inventory and open the part.
  3. Send the create with partNumber "QA256D-{run}" and description D256.
  4. Send the create with partNumber N256 and description "QA S7 256".
  5. Search "QA256D-" on /parts/inventory and in Parts → Part Library; then search "QA255-" on /parts/inventory.
  6. Cleanup: open the new part and click Delete Part (button_delete_part).
custom_expected:
1. 201 with partNumber equal to N255 and description equal to D255 (255 characters each, nothing cut).
  2. One row; Part Number and Description hold the full 255-character values.
  3. 400 with the description "… must be at most 255 characters long." error; nothing is created.
  4. 400 "Part number must be at most 255 characters long."; nothing is created.
  5. No part or Part Library entry QA256D-{run} exists; "QA255-" lists only the N255 part (no 256-character number was created).
  6. The part is deleted at once (no confirmation), the dialog closes and the list reloads without it.
